column3: The Hebrew calls them sons of mighty ones; BSB says heavenly beings.
The Hebrew says splendor of holiness without His, which BSB supplies.
The Hebrew has no explicit is heard in its final clause and describes thundering with a completed verb.
The Hebrew uses nouns with in; BSB uses powerful and majestic.
The Hebrew explicitly has them skipping, then names Lebanon and Sirion; BSB directly makes Lebanon the first object.
The Hebrew says hews flames of fire; BSB says strikes with flames.
The Hebrew describes hinds giving birth; BSB describes twisting oaks.
The Hebrew describes enthronement with completed verbs; BSB uses present verbs.
The Hebrew uses uncompleted verbs for giving and blessing; BSB uses present verbs.
